Empty, error and no-access states for SCR-21 and SCR-22 are in no source document (searched PRD and requirements folder). Section 13 text is not in the supplied parts.

edits.new:
| External dependencies | None |
| Workflow start rule | AssetDisposalWorkflow is started by rwb-case when a repossession completes, a deed in lieu transfer is registered, or the bank takes the property at the enforcement auction (PRD S5 rwb-asset v1). Workflow ID form: Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S5-E3023-APP-8) |
| Personal-data classes of carried fields | The eight asset catalog fields (asset_key, asset_ref, asset_code, asset_type, transfer_in_type, from_segment, transfer_in_date and the collateral key) are not personal data (PRD S5 rwb-asset v1, FSD marking). Bidder and party fields are personal data; this story carries none of them. |
